description: Sample program demonstrating usage of Zephyr's crypto APIs with various cipher modes (ECB, CBC, CTR, CCM, GCM). It performs encryption and decryption using predefined test vectors and checks for correctness.

methods.name: print_buffer_comparison
methods.description: Prints expected and actual buffer contents for comparison.

methods.name: validate_hw_compatibility
methods.description: Checks if the crypto hardware supports required capabilities.

methods.name: ecb_mode
methods.description: Performs AES ECB mode encryption and decryption with test vectors.

methods.name: cbc_mode
methods.description: Performs AES CBC mode encryption and decryption with test vectors.

methods.name: ctr_mode
methods.description: Performs AES CTR mode encryption and decryption with test vectors.

methods.name: ccm_mode
methods.description: Performs AES CCM mode encryption and decryption with test vectors.

methods.name: gcm_mode
methods.description: Performs AES GCM mode encryption and decryption with test vectors.
